note: Environment presentation layer for the Smart Citi game. tagline/description/landmarks/districts are copied verbatim from each world's Master Cards (source schema smartcitix-master-cards/0.1). biome/biomeIcon/hue are game-designed presentation (deterministic keyword rule over the world's own name and tagline — see UPGRADE-PLAN.md), not source data. Game cards only — nothing is minted, deployed, or offered for sale.
biomeRule: First-match keyword scan of (world slug + world name + tagline): health terms -> Clinic Quarter; robotics -> Machine Floor; payments/blockchain -> Ledger District; education/academy/locator -> Academy Grounds; climate/ecology/solar -> Green Belt; empathic -> Quiet Quarter; default -> Civic Core.
